DFS strategy visits pages in depth-first order

```swift title="Swift"
import Crawlberg

let engineConfig = try crawlConfigFromJson("{\"crawl_strategy\":\"dfs\",\"max_concurrent\":1,\"max_depth\":2}")
let engineObj = try createEngine(config: engineConfig)
let url = "https://example.com"
let result = try await Crawlberg.crawl(engine: engineObj, url: url)
debugPrint(result.pages().count)
debugPrint(result.pages()[1].url())
debugPrint(result.pages()[2].url())
debugPrint(result.pages()[3].url())
debugPrint(result.pages()[4].url())
```
